    所有类和接口

    类
    说明
    ByteFormat
    Human-readable byte counts and transfer rates for download/upload progress.
    CompositeSink
    Fan-out sink: e.g. console + log at the same time.
    ConsoleSink
    Console output.
    ConsumerSink
    Sink that hands rendered frames to your own code.
    JdkProgressLogger
    Default ProgressLogger backed by java.util.logging.
    LoggingSink
    Writes one log record per frame line.
    NoopSink
    Sink for pure API usage: values are readable but nothing is printed.
    PrintStreamSink
    Writes each rendered frame to a PrintStream using print or println, whichever fits your output pipeline.
    ProgressBar
    A single progress task.
    ProgressBar.Builder
    Builder for ProgressBar instances.
    ProgressBarDemo
    Runnable showcase of every supported usage mode.
    ProgressConfig
    Immutable configuration shared by a bar or inherited by a group's children.
    ProgressConfig.Builder
    Builder for ProgressConfig instances.
    ProgressFormat
    Template based text renderer.
    ProgressFormatter
    Turns a snapshot into the text you want to show.
    ProgressGroup
    Several progress bars rendered together, one per line.
    ProgressGroup.Builder
    Builder for ProgressGroup instances.
    ProgressGroupFormatter
    Renders an entire group as one frame, so you can add headers, footers or summary lines of your own around the individual progress lines.
    ProgressListener
    Async callbacks.
    ProgressLogger
    Minimal bridge so any logging framework can be plugged in without a compile dependency.
    ProgressLoggers
    Adapters that turn any logging call into a ProgressLogger.
    ProgressReporter
    Generic progress sink for callers: uploaders, downloaders, batch jobs, etc. depend on this interface instead of a concrete bar, so the same code can drive console output, logging, or a silent API-only bar.
    ProgressRunner
    Runs a fixed number of execution steps while keeping a reporter in sync.
    ProgressRunner.IndexedConsumer<T>
    Consumer that also receives the 1-based step index.
    ProgressRunner.Step
    One unit of work; index is 1-based.
    ProgressRunner.UncheckedStep
    Step variant without checked exceptions.
    ProgressSink
    Where a rendered frame goes.
    ProgressSnapshot
    Immutable value object returned by the pure API and delivered to callbacks.
    ProgressStatus
    Lifecycle state of a progress bar.
    ProgressStreams
    Decorators and one-liners that turn byte sources into progress sources.
    ProgressStyle
    Character set used to draw the bar itself.
